mau.an_toan: I am really sorry you are going through this. Right now the most important thing is your safety — no hexagram, chart or house direction decides what your life is worth. If you are thinking about harming yourself or you are in danger, call your local emergency number now. In the US you can call or text 988; in the UK call Samaritans on 116 123; elsewhere, findahelpline.com lists free lines. Please talk to someone you trust today — family, a friend or a counsellor.
mau.tu_choi: This question is outside what the classical arts can answer responsibly (lucky numbers, dates of life and death, diagnosing illness, judging people for hiring, or acting on someone else), so the system does not give a reading. If you like, ask instead how you yourself might handle the situation.
mau.dan_huong: The system does not read spirits, karmic callings, curses or anything from the unseen world — and no one can read those from a birth date or a house direction. If you have been sleeping badly, waking with a start or feeling uneasy lately, a few things help right away: get enough sleep, stop reading news late at night, and tell someone close what is worrying you. If your family keeps an ancestral altar, treat it as a time to come together — the system does not guide rituals or recommend practitioners or objects. You can still ask about work, money, love or the rhythm of this year — things a chart, a hexagram or a house direction can speak to.
mau.chia_buon: Our condolences to you and your family. Losses one after another wear everyone out, and it is natural to look for reasons beyond your control — what matters most now is that the people at home stay close, eat and sleep well, and share the load.

1.y_chinh: Strong creative force that never stops moving; the judgement promises success if you stay upright and steady (yuan heng li zhen). Great Image: the noble person strengthens themselves without rest.
1.loi_khuyen: Take the initiative and keep going, but read the timing: while the dragon is still hidden, do not act; when you have climbed too high, know when to stop.
1.mat_toi: Arrogance and the belief that you are always right — 'the dragon that climbs too high will have regrets'.
1.cau_tu_soi: Are you moving forward because the time has come, or because you cannot bear standing still?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: A time to take on real responsibility and lead; it needs genuine ability underneath — do not skip steps.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Say what you feel first, but respect the other person's pace.
linh_vuc.gia_dinh: The one who holds the family up should lead by example rather than by orders.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Room to grow; avoid putting all your money in because you feel confident.
linh_vuc.hoc_hanh: Study steadily with a long-term goal; avoid taking on too much at once.

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Stay for the long run and build a reputation.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A marriage lasts through commitment.

32.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 32 Heng (Duration) 恆 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

33.y_chinh: Retreat: petty forces are growing and the noble person knows when to withdraw; small matters do well if you keep upright.
33.loi_khuyen: Step back on purpose to save your strength and your principles — it is not running away.
33.mat_toi: Clinging on in a losing position, or retreating out of fear.
33.cau_tu_soi: Are you stepping back to protect yourself, or to avoid something you need to face?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Leave a toxic project or environment, with a plan.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Step back to give each other room to breathe.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Pull money out of risky places.
linh_vuc.hoc_hanh: Step back for now to consolidate.

33.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 33 Dun (Retreat) 遯 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

34.y_chinh: Great power: the yang is at its height; it helps to keep upright; the noble person does not follow what is improper.
34.loi_khuyen: Use your strength with restraint and good form.
34.mat_toi: Aggression — butting ahead like a ram charging a fence.
34.cau_tu_soi: Is the strength you have right now serving something right?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: You have momentum; avoid overpowering others.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Strong yet gentle.
linh_vuc.gia_dinh: Do not use your authority to impose.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Things are rising; do not borrow too heavily.
linh_vuc.hoc_hanh: Study with energy, but keep a steady pace.

34.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 34 Da Zhuang (Great Power) 大壯 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

35.y_chinh: Progress like the sun rising over the earth; you are given trust and responsibility; let your own virtue shine.
35.loi_khuyen: Advance through real ability and a clear conscience.
35.cau_tu_soi: Will this promotion make you better, or only higher?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Promotion, recognition.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: The relationship is moving forward positively.

35.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 35 Jin (Progress) 晉 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

36.y_chinh: The light is wounded: a dark time; it helps to keep upright through hardship, hiding your light while it still shines inside.
36.loi_khuyen: Keep your principles quietly, protect yourself and wait for the right time.
36.mat_toi: Showing off when you are under pressure, or letting go of your principles.
36.cau_tu_soi: What inside you needs to stay bright even when things around you are dark?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: An unfavourable environment; do good work and avoid confrontation.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Hurt; look after yourself first.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Scale down and protect your capital.

36.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 36 Ming Yi (Darkening of the Light) 明夷 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

37.y_chinh: The family: it helps the woman to keep upright; a household with clear roles, words that have substance, actions that have order.
37.loi_khuyen: Strengthen the household routines, keep roles clear, and let your actions match your words.
37.mat_toi: Being domineering, or letting everything slide.
37.cau_tu_soi: In your home, which promise has not yet been matched by action?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: A team culture that feels like family.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Build a shared way of living.

37.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 37 Jia Ren (The Family) 家人 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

38.y_chinh: Opposition, things pulling apart: two people under one roof with different aims; small matters go well.
38.loi_khuyen: Accept the differences, find small common ground and cooperate on small things.
38.mat_toi: Trying to force others to be like you, or cutting them off.
38.cau_tu_soi: What small common ground still exists between you and the person you disagree with?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Different views; find a small task to do together.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Differences; understand rather than correct.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Disagreement over shared money; keep things separate.
linh_vuc.hoc_hanh: Learn from a different point of view.

38.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 38 Kui (Opposition) 睽 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

39.y_chinh: Obstruction, like a lame foot before a dangerous mountain; the south-west is favourable, the north-east is not; it helps to see the great person; turn back and look at yourself.
39.loi_khuyen: Stop and examine yourself, find someone to help, and take the safe way round.
39.cau_tu_soi: Could this obstacle be pointing to something you need to fix in yourself?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: A stalled project; ask for advice.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A rocky relationship; slow down.
linh_vuc.gia_dinh: Hard times at home; sit down together.
linh_vuc.hoc_hanh: A hard part; ask your teacher.

39.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 39 Jian (Obstruction) 蹇 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

40.y_chinh: Deliverance: the trouble has passed, the south-west is favourable; if there is nothing left to do, return; if there is, do it early; forgive mistakes and lighten punishment.
40.loi_khuyen: Settle things quickly and completely, forgive, and go back to normal.
40.mat_toi: Letting the aftermath drag on, holding on to grudges.
40.cau_tu_soi: What is already over that you are still holding on to?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Untie the knot; get things running again.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Forgive and make up.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Pay off the small debts for good.
linh_vuc.hoc_hanh: You get through the hard part.

40.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 40 Xie (Deliverance) 解 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

41.y_chinh: Decrease: take from below to add above; with sincerity, even two simple bowls are enough as an offering.
41.loi_khuyen: Hold back, cut what is excess, and give with purpose.
41.mat_toi: Sacrificing too much, or being stingy.
41.cau_tu_soi: What do you need to cut back to make room for what matters?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Cut costs and unnecessary work.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Ask for less.

41.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 41 Sun (Decrease) 損 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

42.y_chinh: Increase: take from above to add below; it helps to have somewhere to go and to cross the great river; when you see good, follow it; when you have a fault, correct it.
42.loi_khuyen: Seize the time of growth and help others rise with you.
42.mat_toi: Grabbing too much and forgetting to share.
42.cau_tu_soi: What good thing have you seen but not yet followed?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Expansion, with support.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Build each other up.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: A time of increase; invest in what grows.

42.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 42 Yi (Increase) 益 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

43.y_chinh: Breakthrough: remove what is petty; announce it openly at court, honestly warn of the danger; it does not help to take up arms.
43.loi_khuyen: Be decisive and open, and do not use force.
43.cau_tu_soi: Which decision is already clear to you but still not announced?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Make a clear, open decision.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Say clearly what needs to end.

43.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 43 Guai (Breakthrough) 夬 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

44.y_chinh: Coming to meet: one yin meets five yang; do not marry that woman (a small influence that keeps growing).
44.loi_khuyen: Be alert to small influences slipping in; meet people, but keep yourself.
44.cau_tu_soi: Is there a small influence you are letting in that you know you should not?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: An unexpected opportunity; check it carefully.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: An unexpected meeting; slow down before committing.
linh_vuc.gia_dinh: Watch out for small things growing into big ones.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: An attractive opportunity; do your due diligence.

44.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 44 Gou (Coming to Meet) 姤 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

45.y_chinh: Gathering: the king goes to the ancestral temple, it helps to see the great person; a great offering brings good fortune; keep your tools ready for the unexpected.
45.loi_khuyen: Gather people around a shared goal, with a leader, and prepare for surprises.
45.mat_toi: Gathering a crowd without organising it.
45.cau_tu_soi: What connects the people around you?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Meetings, pooling resources.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Introductions, meeting both families.
linh_vuc.hoc_hanh: Study in a group with a goal.

45.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 45 Cui (Gathering) 萃 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

46.y_chinh: Pushing upward: like a tree growing out of the earth, small things building into big ones; see the great person, do not worry; heading south brings good fortune.
46.loi_khuyen: Rise steadily, one step at a time, with the help of someone respected.
46.cau_tu_soi: What is the smallest next step you can take?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Gradual promotion.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: The relationship grows.
linh_vuc.hoc_hanh: Moving up step by step in your studies.

46.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 46 Sheng (Pushing Upward) 升 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

47.y_chinh: Oppression: the lake has run dry; you speak and no one believes you; the great person who keeps upright still meets good fortune.
47.loi_khuyen: Keep your resolve, talk less and let your actions show; save your energy.
47.mat_toi: Complaining, trying hard to convince people.
47.cau_tu_soi: In this tight spot, what can you still hold on to?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Resources are blocked; focus on the core work.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Misunderstandings; actions rather than words.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Running dry; save as much as you can.

47.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 47 Kun (Oppression) 困 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

48.y_chinh: The well: the town changes but the well does not; a shared source that feeds everyone; if the rope does not reach and the bucket breaks, that is misfortune.
48.loi_khuyen: Look after the shared source, maintain it, and see the job through.
48.mat_toi: Giving up just before it is finished; letting the source get polluted.
48.cau_tu_soi: What is your long-term source of nourishment, and are you looking after it?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Infrastructure and core processes.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Keep the original values of the relationship.

48.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 48 Jing (The Well) 井 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

49.y_chinh: Revolution: on the right day you are believed; success, it helps to keep upright, and regret disappears.
49.loi_khuyen: Change things when the time is ripe and people trust you; prepare well.
49.mat_toi: Changing for the sake of change, in a hurry.
49.cau_tu_soi: Is the change you want ripe enough, and do enough people trust it?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Reorganising, changing jobs with preparation.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Change the way you live together.
linh_vuc.gia_dinh: Change old habits that no longer fit.

49.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 49 Ge (Revolution) 革 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

50.y_chinh: The cauldron: cooking to honour the worthy; the new becomes stable; very good, success.
50.loi_khuyen: Stabilise the new, nurture talent, and keep the right position.
50.mat_toi: The cauldron's leg breaks — taking on more than you can carry.
50.cau_tu_soi: What talent (yours or someone else's) are you nurturing?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Build the organisation; value talented people.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Nurture shared values.

50.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 50 Ding (The Cauldron) 鼎 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

51.y_chinh: Thunder: first fear, then laughter and talk; the thunder roars for a hundred miles, yet the sacrificial ladle is not dropped.
51.loi_khuyen: Stay calm through the upheaval; examine and correct yourself.
51.cau_tu_soi: What is this shock reminding you to look at again?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Sudden upheaval; stay calm.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Stormy times; get through them together.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: The market is volatile; do not panic.

51.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 51 Zhen (Arousing Thunder) 震 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

52.y_chinh: Keeping still: stopping at the back, not seeing the body; walking in the courtyard without seeing anyone; no blame.
52.loi_khuyen: Stop at the right moment, quiet your mind, and keep your thoughts within your own place.
52.cau_tu_soi: What do you need to stop today?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Pause and assess.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: A necessary quiet spell.
linh_vuc.hoc_hanh: Rest to let things sink in.

52.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 52 Gen (Keeping Still) 艮 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

53.y_chinh: Gradual progress, like a wild goose flying stage by stage; a woman marrying into her husband's home brings good fortune.
53.loi_khuyen: Move forward in order, without skipping stages.
53.cau_tu_soi: Which step in the sequence are you skipping?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Promotion along a clear path.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Love that grows slowly but surely.
linh_vuc.gia_dinh: Prepare the wedding properly, step by step.

53.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 53 Jian (Gradual Progress) 漸 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

54.y_chinh: The marrying maiden enters her husband's home in a secondary position; going forward brings misfortune, nothing is gained.
54.loi_khuyen: See your position and limits clearly, and do not put yourself at a disadvantage.
54.mat_toi: Accepting a lesser role because you are in a hurry.
54.cau_tu_soi: Are you accepting a position beneath you because you are afraid of missing out?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: An unclear position; clarify your role first.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: An unequal relationship; it needs balancing.
linh_vuc.gia_dinh: Your place in a new family.

54.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 54 Gui Mei (The Marrying Maiden) 歸妹 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

55.y_chinh: Abundance: the king reaches it; do not worry, be like the sun at noon — but after noon the sun begins to set.
55.loi_khuyen: Enjoy and share the time of abundance, and prepare for the decline.
55.cau_tu_soi: While you are at the peak, what are you preparing for the way down?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: A peak of success; plan for the long term.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Full happiness; take care of it.

55.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 55 Feng (Abundance) 豐 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

56.y_chinh: The wanderer: small success; keeping upright on the road brings good fortune.
56.loi_khuyen: In a strange place, be careful, modest and travel light.
56.mat_toi: Arrogance in a foreign place, or feeling lost.
56.cau_tu_soi: In this 'temporary' place, what of yourself do you need to keep?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Business trips, working far away, temporary jobs.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Long-distance love, a temporary relationship.
linh_vuc.gia_dinh: Away from home; stay in touch.
linh_vuc.hoc_hanh: Studying abroad or in a new place.

56.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 56 Lu (The Wanderer) 旅 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

57.y_chinh: Wind: gentle penetration, small success; it helps to see the great person; repeat the instructions so they sink in.
57.loi_khuyen: Act gently, steadily and repeatedly; understand before you act.
57.cau_tu_soi: Are you repeating your message with enough patience?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Persuasion, soft negotiation.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Gently, little by little.

57.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 57 Xun (The Gentle Wind) 巽 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

58.y_chinh: Joy, the lake: success, it helps to keep upright; friends study and practise together.
58.loi_khuyen: Share joy, talk things through, learn with friends.
58.cau_tu_soi: Where does your joy come from — and will it last?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Communication, sales, a cheerful team.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Shared joy.

58.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 58 Dui (The Joyous Lake) 兌 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

59.y_chinh: Dispersion: the king goes to the ancestral temple; it helps to cross the great river — gather people again through a shared trust.
59.loi_khuyen: Melt the rigidity and gather people around shared values.
59.cau_tu_soi: What could bring people together right now?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: A team falling apart; reunite it around a goal.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Distance; find your common ground again.

59.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 59 Huan (Dispersion) 渙 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

60.y_chinh: Limitation: success; but limits that are too harsh cannot be kept for long.
60.mat_toi: Being too strict, or having no limits.
60.cau_tu_soi: Which of your limits is too loose — or too tight?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Discipline with budget and time.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Healthy boundaries.
linh_vuc.hoc_hanh: A study schedule you can keep up.

60.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 60 Jie (Limitation) 節 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

61.y_chinh: Inner truth: sincerity that reaches even pigs and fishes; it helps to cross the great river.
61.loi_khuyen: Keep your word and win people over through sincerity.
61.cau_tu_soi: Which promise do you need to keep for trust to be whole?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Your reputation is an asset.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Trust each other sincerely.

61.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 61 Zhong Fu (Inner Truth) 中孚 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

62.y_chinh: Small excess: small things can be done, great things cannot; the flying bird leaves its call — do not go higher, come down.
62.loi_khuyen: Do small things thoroughly, stay modest, take no big risks.
62.mat_toi: Reaching for something bigger than you can handle.
62.cau_tu_soi: Which small thing should you do really well instead of dreaming of something big?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: Perfect the details.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Pay attention to small things.
linh_vuc.gia_dinh: Look after the small things at home.

62.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 62 Xiao Guo (Small Excess) 小過 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

63.y_chinh: After completion: small success, it helps to keep upright; good at the start, disorder at the end.
63.loi_khuyen: Protect what you have achieved and guard against change after it is done.
63.cau_tu_soi: What could spoil what you have just achieved?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: The project is finished; maintain it.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: Settled; do not get careless.
linh_vuc.gia_dinh: The big job is done; keep the routine.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: Take your profit; guard against risk.

63.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 63 Ji Ji (After Completion) 既濟 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

64.y_chinh: Before completion: the little fox, almost across the river, gets its tail wet; nothing is gained by rushing.
64.loi_khuyen: Be careful on the last stretch, the work is not over; see clearly before acting.
64.mat_toi: Thinking it is finished when it is not.
64.cau_tu_soi: Which final step are you taking lightly?

linh_vuc.cong_viec: The project is not finished; do not be complacent.
linh_vuc.tinh_cam: The relationship is still taking shape.
linh_vuc.tien_bac: The deal is not closed yet.
linh_vuc.hoc_hanh: The exam is close; revise carefully.

64.trich_dan: Zhou Yi (Book of Changes), hexagram 64 Wei Ji (Before Completion) 未濟 (judgement, Tuan commentary, Great Image)

dung_sinh_the.y_nghia: In Plum Blossom this is the most favourable pattern: the circumstances (Use) support the person asking (Body) — things come together easily and there is help.
dung_sinh_the.luu_y: Favourable does not mean you can sit back; notice who or what is supporting you.

the_khac_dung.y_nghia: The person asking has the upper hand over the circumstances — it can succeed, but it takes effort.
the_khac_dung.luu_y: You can win, but it costs energy; count the cost first.

ty_hoa.y_nghia: The same element — balanced; things move along with their natural rhythm.
ty_hoa.luu_y: Smooth, but it can stall; take the initiative.

the_sinh_dung.y_nghia: The person asking has to give a lot (energy drains away) — it wears you down and things rarely go quite as hoped.
the_sinh_dung.luu_y: Look at where you are giving too much.

dung_khac_the.y_nghia: The circumstances are pressing on the person asking — the least favourable pattern in Plum Blossom; be careful or pause.
dung_khac_the.luu_y: Unfavourable is not fixed fate; ask what in the situation is working against you and whether it can be avoided.
